buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 2. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 5 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 3. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should

be submitted. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Preventive Maintenance Service. The seller will provide a minimum of four (04) Preventive maint enance service visits during the year on quarterly basis to carry out functional checkup and adjustment/tu ning as may be required. The date of two consecutive visits must have an interval of at least 60 days. 2. Corrective Maintenance Service. In case of any breakdown of the equipment /system, on receivi ng a call from the buyer (265 SU, AF) C/O 41 WG AF, Jaisalmer, the seller is to provide maintenance service within 24 hours from the time of loading complaints to make the equipment/system serviceable. 3. Replacement of spares. The seller will provide all required spares and consumables during warranty peri od free of cost. 4. Registration of faults. The seller is to provide a telephone number/Fax/e-mail ID to receive and registe r complaints from user (265 SU, AF) C/O 41 WG AF, Jaisalmer on 24x7 basis. 5. Serviceability percentage. Serviceability percentage of at least 95% per quarter is to be ensured. The unserviceability should not exceed 03 days at one time. The downtime will be calculated and include d in addition to warranty period. 6. Technical documentation. All the necessary changes in documentation (technical and operator m anual) for changes carried out on the equipment will be provided the seller. 7. Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) The case for Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) will be underta ken separately by the unit. Quotation for AMC is to be provided by the vender for five years beyond the wa rranty period. AMC will be awarded based on performance basis of the vendor during warranty period. 8. Delivery and installation period. The delivery and installation period will be 12 to 16 weeks or earlier da ys from the effective date of contract. The contract can be cancelled unilaterally by the buyer in case the s ervices are not received within the contracted delivery period. Extension of contracted delivery period will be the sole discretion of the buyer. Installation and commissioning and trial run (testing) of 300 KVA UPS is carried out by the seller on the site in one go and the complete work is to be executed within 12 to 16 wee ks from effective date of contract. 9. Desk and Chair for operator to sit and monitor the system. 10. Demonstration and training at site to be provided to the user. 11.All The materials/ labor required for installation; commissioning shall be supplied by the seller. 12. System warranty 05 and battery warranty minimum 3 years. 13. The complete scope of work for subject UPS has been uploaded under buyer added bid specific ATC. Probable bidders are requested to thoroughly review the buyer-added-bid-specific scope of work and part icipate in bidding process accordingly. .
